sentences.text: The provided rules say a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges in the covered cases, but they do not state any RBI monetary penalty amount for levying prohibited foreclosure charges.
The earlier foreclosure-charge directions were superseded and are no longer in force, so they do not supply an applicable penalty amount now.

missing: the monetary penalty amount for a UCB that levies prohibited foreclosure charges; searched the in-force UCB pre-payment-charge provisions and the superseded foreclosure-charge circulars, but no penalty amount was stated.

missing.searched: in-force UCB pre-payment-charge provisions and superseded foreclosure-charge circulars
